home.title: AstroConnect 2026
home.subtitle: Beijing Joint Astrophysics Postdoc Forum
home.heroVenue: KIAA, Peking University & Department of Astronomy, Tsinghua University · Beijing, China
home.overviewText: AstroConnect 2026 is a joint astrophysics postdoc forum hosted by the Kavli Institute for Astronomy and Astrophysics at Peking University (KIAA) and the Department of Astronomy at Tsinghua University (DoA). The two-day meeting brings together the postdoctoral community to present current research and discuss questions across astronomy and astrophysics.
home.rationaleText: The forum gives participants an opportunity to learn about ongoing work at both institutions, exchange methods and ideas, and identify possible collaborations. Research talks and posters will be complemented by informal conversations and dedicated discussion sessions.
home.scopeIntro: Contributions are welcome across observational, theoretical and computational astrophysics, including:

scope.stars: Stars, stellar evolution and stellar populations
scope.planets: Planets, planet formation and circumstellar discs
scope.compact: Compact objects, high-energy astrophysics and gravitational waves
scope.methods: Instrumentation, data analysis, numerical methods and AI in astronomy

home.formatIntro: The planned programme combines research presentations with ample time for questions, interaction and discussion.
home.talksText: Each talk consists of a 15-minute presentation followed by 3 minutes for questions.
home.postersText: Poster sessions for detailed research exchanges, including a 1-minute flash talk for each poster.
home.breaksText: Ample coffee-break time will allow participants to follow up on presentations, visit posters and continue informal conversations.
home.discussionsText: Separate sessions will be reserved for focused discussion. Potential themes include scientific questions, AI in research, career development and work–life balance. Participants can suggest topics in the registration form.
home.formatNote: Session timings and the final programme will be announced later.
home.kiaaVenue: Kavli Institute for Astronomy and Astrophysics (KIAA), Peking University
home.venueNote: Daily venue assignments and meeting rooms will be announced.
home.deadlineTime: Both deadlines are at 23:59 China Standard Time (UTC+8).
home.registrationHelp: Registration and abstract submission use a single form. Select Talk or Poster to include an abstract.
home.meals: Lunch is provided, along with dinner on the first day (14 December).

program.title: Programme
program.intro: AstroConnect 2026 takes place on 14–15 December 2026 in Beijing. The planned programme includes approximately 20 research talks (15 minutes + 3 minutes Q&A), 25 posters, extended coffee breaks and dedicated discussion sessions. The detailed timetable and speaker list will be announced later.
program.notice: The 2025 speaker list is not the 2026 programme.
program.talksText: Approximately 20 talks are planned. Each speaker has 15 minutes for the presentation and 3 minutes for questions.
program.postersText: Approximately 25 posters are planned. Each poster presenter will give a 1-minute flash talk, followed by opportunities for individual discussions.
program.discussionText: Dedicated discussion sessions and extended coffee breaks will provide time for scientific exchanges and topics suggested by participants.
program.ctaText: Register and include your talk or poster abstract in one submission.
